records.title: Sora 2
records.summary: OpenAI's video generation model family. Its API access ended in September 2026.
records.why_it_matters: Many guides and skills still call it. Anything that depends on the Videos API no longer runs.
records.fit_notes: Do not build on it. The deprecations entry lists no replacement model.
records.status_note: API removed 2026-09-24 per OpenAI's deprecations page.

claims.text: OpenAI removed the Sora 2 models and the Videos API from its API on 2026-09-24.
claims.quote: On March 24th, 2026, we notified developers using the Videos API and Sora 2 video generation model aliases and snapshots of their deprecation and removal from the API on September 24, 2026.

checked.what: OpenAI deprecations page against the claim

records.title: Veo 3.1
records.summary: Google's video generation model. It was removed from the Gemini API in October 2026.
records.why_it_matters: Code and skills that call Veo through the Gemini API need to migrate.
records.fit_notes: Whether it stays available on Google's enterprise platform or through resellers was not checked.
records.status_note: Left the Gemini API 2026-10-22. Other access routes not checked.

claims.text: The Gemini API lists a shutdown date of 2026-10-22 for veo-3.1-generate-preview and names gemini-omni-1.2-flash as the replacement.

checked.what: Gemini API deprecations page against the claim

records.title: Gemini Omni Flash
records.summary: Google's video generation and editing model on the Gemini API, with audio.
records.why_it_matters: It is the replacement Google names for Veo 3.1 on the Gemini API.
records.fit_notes: Paid tier only, so it cannot be tried for free. Priced in output tokens; the per-second figures are Google's own approximation.

claims.text: Google prices 720p output at about $0.07 per second, so a 10 second clip is about $0.70.
claims.quote: approximately $0.07 per second (~$0.70 for a 10s clip, ~$1.04 for a 15s clip;
claims.locator: Gemini API pricing page, section Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash

claims.text: It generates and edits up to 15 seconds of video with audio, on the paid tier only.
claims.quote: up to 15 seconds of video generation and editing with native audio, now generally available to developers on the paid tier of the Gemini API.
claims.locator: Gemini API pricing page, section Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash

checked.what: Gemini API pricing page against both claims

records.title: MiniMax H3
records.summary: An open-weights video generation model from MiniMax, also sold through its API.
records.why_it_matters: A leading open-weights video model whose licence does not cover several major regions.
records.fit_notes: Read the licence for where you are before using the weights. Ports for Apple Silicon exist, but the one published timing is minutes per denoising step on a larger machine, and nothing was measured here.

claims.text: The licence defines the EU, the UK, South Korea and the USA as excluded territories.
claims.quote: “Excluded Territories” means the European Union, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Korea and the United States of America.

claims.text: The licence applies worldwide except those territories.
claims.quote: “Applicable Territory” means worldwide, excluding the Excluded Territories.

checked.what: LICENSE file on the model repository against both claims
